subpageUsage: Same EnterpriseSlider component as the homepage with its real `variant` prop set to "case" (homepage = "feature"). The case variant (.case-studies-story-section, related-3col-slider) renders a centred H2 with no button, then the 3-up (2-up 768-991, 1-up <768) looping slider of linked surface-1 cards (min-h 23rem, radius 12, padding 24): customer logo top-left, 20px headline text bottom, background colour .2s on hover; the progress-bullet pagination with pause button sits underneath. Used on the five /case-study/customer-1..5 routes (src/pages/content/CaseStudyPlatform.jsx) with the same six RELATED_SLIDES from caseStudyPlatformData.js on every route.
evidenceNotes: `variant` is a real prop on EnterpriseSlider ('feature' | 'case'); the homepage uses the default 'feature'.
RELATED_SLIDES is shared by all five /case-study/customer-N routes, so each route links to itself among the six cards (the route's own customer is not filtered out).
Each card is an <a href="#"> (link targets are contract-owned).
